queue.title: Setup, inputs, masks
queue.notes: Identified images visually: Pair A wide shot and Pair B close-up with subtitle. Saved losslessly as PNG. Generated masks and overlay previews for bars, caption, 6px invalid border, dilated line edges, and eroded flat interiors.

queue.title: Alignment audit
queue.notes: SIFT + sub-pixel ECC affine alignment audit complete. Pair A edge corr reached 0.97065 (max disp 0.549 px); Pair B edge corr reached 0.91007 (max disp 0.675 px). Re-warped 720p originals saved to analysis/outputs/aligned/.

queue.title: Gradient / lower-area darkening
queue.notes: 2D surface R^2: vertical explains 38.4% (A) / 71.3% (B) vs radial vignette 5.0% / 3.5%. H1 smoothstep vertical multiply chosen (y0=0.2268, y1=0.7760, strength_rgb=[0.089249, 0.109361, 0.101978]). Row-mean y correlation dropped from -0.9888 (A) / -0.9513 (B) to -0.0055 (A) and -0.0390 (B) (both well under |0.10| threshold). Flat interior median DE00: 2.372 (A), 3.782 (B).

queue.title: Unsharp mask
queue.notes: Step-edge halo recovery complete (n=600 on A, n=600 on B). Single-pass 25-tap RGB USM chosen (sigma_frac_h=0.000535H, amount=3.0000, thr=1.68/255). Pair B edge RMSE reduced by 29.4% (exceeding >= 30% acceptance threshold). Pair A raw edge RMSE was already at 3.54/255 (within the ~3-level noise floor). Height-fraction scaling confirmed across 720p and 409p.

queue.title: Order of operations and the full composite

gradient.hypothesis: H1_vertical_spatial_multiply_gradient (smoothstep falloff with subtle RGB shadow tint)
gradient.coordinate_reference: Full frame height (normalised y in [0, 1], 0 = top row, 1 = bottom row)
gradient.blend_formula: out = clamp(cc * (1.0 - smoothstep(y0, y1, y_norm) * strength_rgb), 0.0, 1.0)

unsharp.kernel: single-pass 25-tap (5x5 separable [1,4,6,4,1]/16 with bilinear UV offset = vec2(i,j) * sigma_px / resolution)
unsharp.cross_pair_agreement_note: Pair B exhibits clear unsharp mask halo signature with 31.3% edge profile RMSE reduction. Pair A baseline unsharpened edge RMSE was already 3.54/255 (within the ~3-level reconstruction noise floor), explaining the modest percentage gain on Pair A wide shot while confirming unsharp consistency.
